newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ticor, DuPont discuss cyanide j/v.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ticor, DuPont discuss cyanide j/v.

text.p: Ticor Ltd unit Ticor Chemicals Pty Ltd said it was holding talks with DuPont Co's DuPont (Australia) Ltd on a joint venture expansion of Ticor's sodium cyanide plant at Gladstone in Queensland.
"Negotiations are continuing with DuPont which if successful, will see a doubling of Ticor's plant to 43,000 tonnes a year," a Ticor spokesman told Reuters.
Ticor had been operating its Gladstone factory for about four years with most of the output being sold in solid form to the local gold mining industry.
If the joint venture went ahead, DuPont and Ticor were planning to boost exports to 12-15,000 tonnes annually to Papua New Guinea, New Zealand, Indonesia and other Asian markets, the spokesman said.
Ticor's factory was one of two operating in Gladstone -- the city's other sodium cyanide production plant is owned by ICI Australia Ltd, the Ticor spokesman said.
In the first half ended June 30, Ticor's cyanide plant raised sales to A$26 million from A$22.2 million a year earlier.
DuPont executives were not available for comment.
